title: Germ comparison for an already descended local factorization
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $x\in W\subseteq V\subseteq U\subseteq X$ open neighborhoods, and $A$ a module sheaf on $U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Let $b:A\to\mathcal F|_U$ be an epimorphism. Suppose $\psi:A|_V\to\mathcal G|_V$ has germ action $\psi_Z(t)_x=\chi(b_Z(t)_x)$ for all $x\in Z\subseteq V$ and $t\in A(Z)$, where $\chi:\mathcal F_x\to\mathcal G_x$ is a linear map [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. Suppose a morphism $\theta:(\mathcal F|_U)|_V|_W\to(\mathcal G|_V)|_W$ is already given with $b|_W$ followed by $\theta$ equal to $\psi|_W$. Then there is $\varphi\in\mathcal Hom(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)(W)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom] such that for every $x\in Z\subseteq W$ and $s\in\mathcal F(Z)$, $\varphi_Z(s)_x=\chi(s_x)$. No finite-generation or finite-presentation hypothesis is imposed; the lift psi and descent theta are hypotheses, not conclusions.

source.place: Tag 01CP, lemma-stalk-internal-hom, third paragraph; finite-coordinate construction and its finite-type vanishing argument.

proof.text: Construct eF by mapping overFunctorMap R i along restriction to W and composing with overFunctorMap R j; let eG be overFunctorMap R j. The presheaf morphism underlying eF.inv composed with theta composed with eG.hom is the required internal-Hom section phi.

For a section s over Z inside W containing x, apply local module epi germ lifting to b to obtain a section t over a smaller Z' whose image has the same germ as s. The stalk internal-Hom evaluation formula respects that equality.

Apply congrArg to htheta at the smaller neighborhood and its lifted section t. The canonical restriction isomorphisms act by identities on section carriers, so this gives phi(b(t)) = psi(t). Rewrite via the stalk evaluation formula and the equality of source germs; apply the assumed formula hpsi. This is the complete Lean proof.

proof_origin.note: Second reader R3 closed this theorem using SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap, exists_local_module_epi_germ_lift, exists_stalk_internalHom_linearMap, and componentwise evaluation of htheta. Axiom probe shows only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

mathlib_searches.query: A factorization of a local morphism through an epimorphism induces the prescribed stalk map if it agrees after the epimorphism
If two morphisms agree on stalk germs after an epimorphism of sheaves of modules, they agree on all section germs
mathlib_searches.results: stalk_hom_ext, germ_ext, germ_eq and GeneratingSections.ofEpi_s; no iterated local module factorization formula.
Existing germ representation/equality, free sheaf universal properties and covering sieve APIs; no combined finite free local lifting or shrinking statement.

from.place: step 7 of its split (source: Lemma 0GS2, proof: the essential-surjectivity paragraphs; the coherent stalk-map extension used in the coherent devissage route); this refinement serves Finite-presentation coordinate kernel on module stalks in the proof of 01CP; refinement: Tag 01CP, proof, third paragraph: finite-coordinate kernel lifting, expanded using representatives and the presentation cokernel.; refinement: final comparison of an already descended map using the source epimorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_internalHom_of_local_stalk_factorization
    (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (F G : Modules X) (x : X)
    (U V W : Opens X) (hxW : x ∈ W) (i : V ⟶ U) (j : W ⟶ V)
    (A : SheafOfModules.{u} (((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf).over U))
    (b : A ⟶ F.over U) [Epi b]
    (ψ : (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf) i).obj A ⟶ G.over V)
    (χ : (moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj F →ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x]
      (moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj G)
    (hψ : ∀ (Z : Opens X) (k : Z ⟶ V) (hxZ : x ∈ Z)
      (t : A.val.obj (op (Over.mk (k ≫ i)))),
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf Z x hxZ
        (ψ.val.app (op (Over.mk k)) t) =
      χ (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf Z x hxZ
        (b.val.app (op (Over.mk (k ≫ i))) t)))
    (θ : (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf) j).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf) i).obj (F.over U)) ⟶
      (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf) j).obj (G.over V))
    (hθ : (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf) j).map
        ((SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf) i).map b) ≫ θ =
      (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf) j).map ψ) :
    ∃ (φ : (F.homObj G).val.obj (op W)),
      ∀ (Z : Opens X) (k : Z ⟶ W) (hxZ : x ∈ Z) (s : F.val.obj (op Z)),
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf Z x hxZ (φ.app (op (Over.mk k)) s) =
          χ (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf Z x hxZ s)
